From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: book 30m showcase and designate SME

Hi Emma — great to meet you and Raj on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- What we heard: you want a short, concrete demo that focuses on low-latency inference for real-time dashboards, data residency options, and an initial cost projection for your weekly batch workload.
- Goal for next meeting: 30-minute product showcase + short Q&A (we'll show latency numbers, caching/quantization options, and a roadmap for a scoped pilot).

Please confirm which of these 30-minute windows works for your team (we cast times in PST):
1) Tue Dec 8 — 10:00–10:30 PST (preferred for our infra SME)
2) Wed Dec 9 — 14:00–14:30 PST (works for east-coast stakeholders)
3) Thu Dec 10 — open band: we can do 9:00–11:00 PST; if you pick a time we will lock it.

Two quick asks so we can tailor the demo:
- Can you nominate one technical owner (SRE/infra) and one security/contact for the preread?
- Any specific sample payload sizes or sequence lengths we should include in the demo traces?

I've attached a short one-pager and a working mutual action plan to speed up logistics, plus a security preread checklist you can share with your ops/security contact.

If you confirm a slot, I will send a calendar invite and a brief prep doc for attendees.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
